description: This source file defines the AWS GlobalAcceleratorClient class, which is used to interact with the AWS Global Accelerator service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, and describing accelerators, endpoints, and related resources. The class extends AwsClient and serves as a client interface for the AWS SDK in PHP.

classes.name: GlobalAcceleratorClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Global Accelerator service, providing methods for managing accelerators and related resources.

methods.name: addCustomRoutingEndpoints
methods.description: Adds custom routing endpoints to an accelerator.

methods.name: addEndpoints
methods.description: Adds endpoints to an endpoint group.

methods.name: createAccelerator
methods.description: Creates a new AWS Global Accelerator.

methods.name: describeAccelerator
methods.description: Describes the details of a specific accelerator.

methods.name: listAccelerators
methods.description: Lists all accelerators associated with the account.
